item.title: Hotels Have Made Progress on Women in Leadership. But the Pipeline Is Thin.
item.description: Hotels have more women executives at the top of their organizations than they used to. But the middle-ranks still don't have enough of a sustainable pipeline of future leaders.

item.title: TSA PreCheck Remains Operational After DHS Said It Would Suspend Program
item.description: DHS is suspending two widely used travel programs as the partial government shutdown continues.

item.title: Airlines Cancel Over 7,000 Flights as Blizzard Hits Northeast
item.description: As a blizzard is slated to dump at least a foot of snow in much of the Northeast, airlines are canceling thousands of flights.

item.title: Seoul-Based Travel Platform Launches Expert-Led K-Beauty Tours
item.description: Knowing about Korean skincare from a YouTube video is different from standing inside an Olive Young store with 400 serums and no idea which one won't irritate your skin. NOL World is looking to solve that confusion.

item.title: Oneworld Appoints New CEO as Airline Alliances Fight for Relevance
item.description: As joint ventures and other bespoke partnerships reshape global aviation, alliances must prove they still matter.

item.title: Airlines Suspend Flights to Puerto Vallarta as Unrest Erupts in Mexico
item.description: Travelers were left stranded in Puerto Vallarta as violence broke out throughout the country following the killing of the cartel leader of one of Mexico’s most powerful criminal organizations.

item.title: Airlines Cancel 10,000+ Flights as Blizzard Slams Northeast
item.description: Expect disruptions to linger: For Tuesday, there were already 1,850 cancellations, and nearly half the flights out of LaGuardia, JFK, Newark, and Boston are canceled.

item.title: Airbnb Is Testing Airport Pickups. Are Flights Next?
item.description: Airbnb likely sees how flights are driving Booking Holdings' connected-trip vision. The timing is unclear, but it needs flights if it wants to be a true "travel concierge."

item.title: Hoteliers Scramble to Price U.S. Tariff Risk
item.description: Hotels are exposed to trade policy the way airlines are exposed to shifts in fuel pricing.

item.title: Global Destinations Compete for Indian Tourists With Easier Visas
item.description: The visa relaxations for India are slow, but they all mean the same thing. Indian travelers are important to global travel, and everyone wants a piece of the Indian outbound pie.
